title: Aureline M5 retirement impact report
description: Canonical per-domain retirement impact report for a command / deep link or registry-visible package reaching Retired. Names the object class, its supported-line association, whether no-new-install and no-new-tenant gating is enforced, whether the class was removed from selection surfaces (command palette, marketplace listing, upgrade flow), and the successor path so no dangling deep link or stale marketplace listing stays selectable. Downstream install/update, marketplace/registry, support, and partner/procurement surfaces point at this schema instead of restating retirement impact by hand. Raw secret values and private endpoints never cross this boundary.
